answer_1.quote: Specifically, we focus on abstaining in questionanswering (AbstainQA): given an LLM and a question q, we aim to develop an abstain function f (LLM, q) → {true, false} to indicate whether the LLMs should abstain based on the limitations of their internal knowledge.

answer_2.quote: We illustrate the four scenarios under AbstainQA in Figure 2 and employ the following evaluation metrics. (1) Reliable Accuracy (R-Acc): A A+C indicates to what extent could LLM-generated answers (not abstained) be trusted. i.e., out of all questions answered, how many are correct? (2) Effective Reliability (ER) (Whitehead et al., 2022; Si et al., 2023): A-C A+B+C+D strikes a balance between reliability and coverage. i.e., out of all questions, what proportion more are answered correctly than incorrectly?
